packages.name: GTA VI-Inspired HUD (Single Player)
packages.author: Geckomacabre / credited contributors
packages.licence: Review repository and all bundled third-party component licences before managed redistribution
packages.minimumGameBuild: Not specified; verify exact Legacy build
packages.maximumGameBuild: Not specified; verify exact Legacy build
packages.installAdapter: OpenIV OIV package adapter required; current Hub importer only quarantines and inventories the container
packages.restoreStrategy: Use a verified OIV-specific transaction and restore plan for mods/update.rpf plus any root ASI files; not implemented
packages.performanceTier: Unknown; upstream reports functional Legacy release, but no 1080p RTX 4050 frame-time/VRAM benchmark
packages.notes: Upstream Legacy install guide describes GTA-VI-Inspired-HUD-2.8.2-Legacy.oiv installed through OpenIV Package Installer into the mods folder. Requires Script Hook V and Script Hook V .NET 3.7.0 Nightly 193 or newer, plus OpenIV/ASI Loader setup. Upstream states the HUD is English-only; other game languages can show empty boxes and character switching has reportedly crashed. Features include a GTA VI-inspired HUD, 3D minimap, character switcher, additional gameplay systems and optional loading screens; it is not a full replacement of every title/pause/map/settings screen and it does not supply Jason or Lucia models. The upstream README states some HUD art is sourced from Rockstar's official GTA VI media. Review all rights/licences and do not bundle the OIV or third-party character assets. Pin the upstream archive SHA-256, verify the exact Legacy build and nested OIV manifest, and complete safe install/rollback and RTX 4050 testing before approval.
externalRequirements: Script Hook V .NET 3.7.0 Nightly 193 or newer
OpenIV with ASI Loader and OpenIV.asi
GTA V language set to English
Optional: separately sourced compatible Jason and/or Lucia character model (not included)

packages.name: Pause Menu Library
packages.author: SloRey
packages.licence: Free for personal, non-commercial GTA V single-player use only. Do not modify/re-upload, decompile or reverse engineer. The author explicitly prohibits redistributing PauseMenuLibrary.asi.
packages.minimumGameBuild: Current supported GTA V Legacy build; exact pattern range to verify
packages.installAdapter: External framework prerequisite; managed installation is not permitted until exact rights and a user-owned download workflow are established
packages.restoreStrategy: User-managed removal only unless author grants explicit redistribution and automation permission
packages.performanceTier: Unknown; native pause-menu API integration overhead unmeasured
packages.notes: Framework for mod authors to add pages, tabs, toggles, sliders and key-binding pages inside GTA V's native pause menu. It does nothing on its own and is not a standalone GTA VI menu replacement. Requires the latest Script Hook V and a separate mod authored to use the API. Source lists GTA V Legacy and Enhanced; a user report shows an older Legacy executable build 1.0.3725.0 did not match the library's required patterns while 1.0.3889.0 was cited by the author as the then-current Legacy build. Treat exact game-build compatibility as mandatory. The author's licence forbids uploading or redistributing PauseMenuLibrary.asi; link to the author source only.
externalRequirements: A separate mod specifically built against the Pause Menu Library API
User must obtain PauseMenuLibrary.asi from the author source; Hub must not bundle it

profiles.name: Performance Priority
profiles.description: A future low-overhead profile. Enable only packages with measured performance impact.

profiles.name: Story Expansion
profiles.description: A future gameplay/story profile. Enable only tested single-player packages with pinned dependencies.

profiles.name: Story & World Expansion
profiles.description: Prioritises compatible single-player story expansions, side missions, activities, interiors and ambient world systems. Every mission pack must be tested for save compatibility and load order.

profiles.name: Accessibility & Comfort
profiles.description: Prioritises readable UI, subtitle clarity, control flexibility, camera comfort, audio clarity and other verified accessibility improvements. Native game settings are preferred over risky modifications.
